      "snippet": "Yeah, your brain are smart 😄 and you’re right to call out the plug-and-play meaning here.

You were thinking:

“Plug and play” = I upload a new delta, and it just plugs in and the OS starts using it.

What I described before was more:

“Plug and play” = modular engines/packs that can be toggled on/off via config.

Those are related but not identical. So:

✅ Module-level plug-and-play (packs) — already wired with the PackConfig.

✅ Delta-level plug-and-play (what you meant) — I’ve now formalized "
